title: A few months at Illinois, then the call to join the Collegians
summary: After starting at the University of Illinois he leaves in November 1925 when Jack Tebo calls about vaudeville act The Collegians; Dance asks what he planned to study.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So, in the FALL, after that tour was over, I went to Champagne. And I really enjoyed it. I went home for a couple of days and then went over to the University of Illinois and registered, started. Well, in November I get a call from this same Jack Techo, who's producing an act called The Collegians, who were going in vaudeville, they were going to California. This was 1925. I couldn't stand it. I just -- I left school --
Red, listen. Tell me something, what were you going to study at college?
I don't know, I guess I was gonna -- you mean what --
Yeah, what were you supposed to be going to do, what did you think you were going to do with your life?
I don't know. I was just going for a BA. degree, my brothers and sisters were all college --
What? They studied engineering. One brother was a geologist and the other was a geologist.
Yeah. So you were going to do something the same?
Well I started that because I wanted to -- I wasn't quite decided what I wanted to do.
Yeah. But up until then, it never occurred to you do anything but go to college, huh?
You just thought you would go to college and see what you were going to do.
